cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton, and in the early hours of Sunday, the 20th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿。周日凌晨，9月20日，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Ed Sheeran calls the situation in Gaza catastrophic at his first concert since rapper Macklemore was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour over pro-Palestinian comments.
cues.zh: Ed Sheeran称加沙局势是灾难性的；此前说出亲巴勒斯坦言论的说唱歌手Macklemore被取消巡演资格，这是他之后的首场演出。

cues.en: Children in Gaza return to damaged schools for their first formal schooling after nearly three years of war.
cues.zh: 加沙儿童回到受损的学校，在近三年战争后首次接受正式教育。

cues.en: And the Houthis in Yemen say they've launched missiles and drones at targets in Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh.
cues.zh: 也门胡塞武装称，他们向包括利雅得在内的沙特目标发射了导弹和无人机。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, how missing Y chromosomes could be an early warning sign of cancer.
cues.zh: 本期还将介绍，Y染色体缺失为何可能是癌症的早期预警信号。

cues.en: And it becomes a larger meditation, I hope, about time and the mysteries of being alive and fate.
cues.zh: 还有一部纪录片，希望能引发人们对时间、生命奥秘和命运的更深思考。

cues.en: A documentary filmmaker interviews the world's oldest people.
cues.zh: 一位纪录片导演采访了世界上最长寿的人们。

cues.en: Ed Sheeran's been in the spotlight since rapper Macklemore was dropped from his tour after making pro-Palestinian remarks.
cues.zh: 说唱歌手Macklemore发表亲巴勒斯坦言论、被取消巡演资格后，Ed Sheeran一直处于聚光灯下。

cues.en: All of the British singer's supporting acts, including his band, withdrew from the tour in solidarity, and ticket prices fell dramatically.
cues.zh: 这位英国歌手的所有助演嘉宾，包括他的乐队，都为表示声援而退出巡演，票价也大幅下跌。

cues.en: But Ed Sheeran pushed ahead, and at a solo concert in Philadelphia, he addressed the controversy for the first time.
cues.zh: 但Ed Sheeran仍继续巡演，并在费城的一场个人演唱会上首次回应这场争议。

cues.en: I've tried in my career not to be a political commentator of any kind because I want my music and shows to be about unity, not division, about humanity, not politics.
cues.zh: 我一直努力不在职业生涯中充当任何形式的政治评论员，因为我希望我的音乐和演出关乎团结而非分裂，关乎人性而非政治。

cues.en: But this is a humanitarian issue and I cannot hide how I feel about it anymore.
cues.zh: 但这是一个人道主义问题，我再也无法隐藏自己对此的感受。

cues.en: What happened in Israel and at the Nova Music Festival on October 7th was horrific and compounded centuries of Jewish pain.
cues.zh: 10月7日在以色列和Nova音乐节发生的事情令人恐惧，也加重了犹太人数百年来的痛苦。

cues.en: What is happening in Gaza is catastrophic, and unjustifiable, and disproportionate.
cues.zh: 加沙正在发生的事情是灾难性的、无法正当化的，也是完全不成比例的。

cues.en: My heart has been broken by the scale of devastation and loss of civilians' lives, of children's lives.
cues.zh: 大规模的破坏，以及平民尤其是儿童的丧生，令我心碎。

cues.en: And the systemic injustice we're seeing unfold in the West Bank cannot be overlooked.
cues.zh: 我们看到约旦河西岸正在发生的系统性不公，也不容忽视。

cues.en: I am already speaking to people across the spectrum to work out how to make a contribution that helps victims of these terrible times.
cues.zh: 我已经在和各方人士交谈，想办法作出贡献，帮助这些苦难时期的受害者。

cues.en: And listening, and learning, because I do not know enough.
cues.zh: 我也在倾听和学习，因为我知道得还不够多。

cues.en: There was a notable police presence at the stadium in Philadelphia as dozens of pro-Palestinian protesters gathered outside.
cues.zh: 费城体育场外聚集了数十名亲巴勒斯坦抗议者，现场有大量警察驻守。

cues.en: We need more people like Macklemore, and like other artists who have a voice, who have a public platform.
cues.zh: 我们需要更多像Macklemore这样的艺术家，也需要其他拥有声音和公共平台的人。

cues.en: To be able to speak on behalf of the Palestinian people and their struggle for liberation.
cues.zh: 他们能够代表巴勒斯坦人民及其争取解放的斗争发声。

cues.en: I'm in solidarity with the Palestinian people. I certainly know, as a Black man in America, how it feels to be oppressed.
cues.zh: 我与巴勒斯坦人民站在一起。作为美国的一名黑人，我当然知道受到压迫是什么感受。

cues.en: And genocide is wrong, and people have to have the courage from all walks of life to stand up and speak out against it.
cues.zh: 种族灭绝是错误的，各行各业的人都必须鼓起勇气站出来，发声反对它。

cues.en: Our correspondent, Karl Nassman, spoke to me from outside the venue.
cues.zh: 我们的记者卡尔·纳斯曼在场馆外接受了我的采访。

cues.en: We were in some of the first rows of the concert tonight, and everybody was waiting to hear how Ed Sheeran would address the controversy.
cues.zh: 今晚我们坐在演唱会前排，所有人都在等着听Ed Sheeran会如何回应这场争议。

cues.en: The controversy of the past few days and weeks on his tour.
cues.zh: 这场围绕他巡演、持续了几天乃至几周的争议。

cues.en: And it was really the first thing he did.
cues.zh: 而这确实是他做的第一件事。

cues.en: He walked out on stage by himself and started to talk everyone through what he'd been thinking.
cues.zh: 他独自走上舞台，开始向大家讲述自己的想法。

cues.en: And you could hear the room was silent. The stadium was really rapt and paying attention.
cues.zh: 你能听到全场一片寂静，体育场里的观众全神贯注。

cues.en: They were paying attention to every word he said, and it seemed to go down very well.
cues.zh: 他们认真听着他说的每一句话，而这番话似乎得到了很好的反响。

cues.en: I think a lot of people were relieved that he came out and spoke about what had been on his mind.
cues.zh: 我想，很多人都因他走出来说出心里话而松了一口气。

cues.en: Especially addressing the situation in the Middle East and the situation with rapper Macklemore being dropped from his tour.
cues.zh: 尤其是回应中东局势，以及说唱歌手Macklemore被取消巡演资格一事。

cues.en: And I should say, the biggest applause and reaction to the speech was when he said he was determined to continue his tour.
cues.zh: 我得说，演讲获得最热烈掌声和反应的时刻，是他说自己决心继续巡演。

cues.en: He wanted to come tonight and play for all these fans.
cues.zh: 他说今晚想来为所有这些歌迷演出。

cues.en: Even though he said he had no backing band and no warm-up acts, he was committed to continuing this tour.
cues.zh: 尽管他说自己没有伴奏乐队，也没有暖场嘉宾，但他仍决心继续这次巡演。

cues.en: Because he said he was there really to perform for his tens of thousands of fans tonight.
cues.zh: 因为他说，自己今晚到场就是为了给数万名歌迷演出。

cues.en: So Ed Sheeran was standing alone on stage. We were expecting a very stripped-back show. What was it like?
cues.zh: 所以Ed Sheeran是独自站在舞台上。我们原以为会是一场极简的演出，实际情况如何？

cues.en: Yeah, it was one of those shows that really demonstrates how talented Ed Sheeran is as an artist.
cues.zh: 是的，这场演出充分展现了Ed Sheeran作为艺术家的才华。

cues.en: He was just there with him and his guitar, and he was using one of these loop machines.
cues.zh: 现场只有他和他的吉他，他还使用了一台循环录音设备。

cues.en: He could play a few chords, record that, then play another few chords.
cues.zh: 他可以弹奏几个和弦并录下来，然后再弹奏几个和弦。

cues.en: He'd record a bit of vocalization, and he loops it and loops it, making it into this rich, amazing backing track.
cues.zh: 他会录下一些哼唱，不断循环，把它制作成丰富而精彩的伴奏音轨。

cues.en: He would then perform to that, maybe for his first five or six songs that way.
cues.zh: 随后他就用这条音轨演出，前五六首歌可能都是这样完成的。

cues.en: And then in the middle of the concert, there was a bit of a surprise.
cues.zh: 然后在演唱会进行到一半时，出现了一个小惊喜。

cues.en: He said he had about three days to come up with a backing band that could make it to Philadelphia.
cues.zh: 他说，自己只有大约三天时间组建一支能够赶到费城的伴奏乐队。

cues.en: That could learn the songs he wanted to perform.
cues.zh: 这支乐队还要学会他想演出的歌曲。

cues.en: Because he really emphasized he didn't want this concert to change too much for the people that paid to get into the venue.
cues.zh: 因为他特别强调，不希望这场演出对那些买票入场的人发生太大改变。

cues.en: He managed to find friends who could play drums, fiddle and guitar, and help create this amazing atmosphere.
cues.zh: 他找来一些会打鼓、拉小提琴、弹吉他的朋友，真正营造出这种令人惊叹的氛围。

cues.en: So it was really a fun night.
cues.zh: 所以那确实是一个非常愉快的夜晚。

cues.en: There was actually an emotional moment midway through the concert, when he said, ‘Hey...
cues.zh: 演唱会进行到一半时，确实有一个感人的时刻，他说：“嘿……”

cues.en: I don't know if you've been looking recently at social media, but there's been a lot of chatter about me and about this concert.’
cues.zh: 我不知道你最近有没有看社交媒体，但关于我和这场演唱会的议论很多。

cues.en: I was worried, he said, about the way that I might be received here by you.’
cues.zh: 他说，他担心自己在这里会受到大家怎样的对待。

cues.en: And that was when the entire stadium erupted into applause, really to support Ed Sheeran in that moment.
cues.zh: 就在那时，整个体育场爆发出掌声，显然是在支持当时的 Ed Sheeran。

cues.en: I think that kind of shows you. I think there have been some doubts about Ed Sheeran.
cues.zh: 我觉得这多少说明了一些问题。我认为人们确实对 Ed Sheeran 有过一些疑虑。

cues.en: Maybe the way that he handled this, and he admitted that he made mistakes, but clearly he really had the support of that stadium tonight.
cues.zh: 也许人们质疑的是他处理这件事的方式；他承认自己犯了错，但显然今晚整个体育场都支持他。

cues.en: So, Karl, what's your sense of this now? Will this statement on stage have made any difference? Will this issue go away for Ed Sheeran?
cues.zh: 那么，Karl，你现在怎么看？这番台上声明会带来什么改变吗？这件事会从 Ed Sheeran 身上过去吗？

cues.en: We'll have to see how it plays out, especially next week. He'll perform at Gillette Stadium, whose owner, Robert Kraft...
cues.zh: 我想还得看看事态如何发展，尤其是下周；他将在吉列体育场演出，而该场馆的所有者 Robert Kraft……

cues.en: was reportedly one of the biggest factors in trying to get Macklemore dropped from this tour.
cues.zh: 据报道，Robert Kraft 是试图让 Macklemore 退出这次巡演的最大因素之一。

cues.en: It will be interesting to see next week how he is received there, at a stadium just outside Boston.
cues.zh: 所以我想，下周看看他在那里受到怎样的接待会很有意思；那座体育场就在波士顿郊外。

cues.en: Overall, this may have put some doubts to bed. I think he said just enough to stay above the issue of the war in Gaza.
cues.zh: 但总的来说，这或许打消了一些疑虑。我觉得他的话恰到好处，让自己某种程度上置身于加沙战争问题之外。

cues.en: Those comments may be strong enough for people who wanted a stronger stance when the controversy began.
cues.zh: 但我认为，对于那些希望他在争议刚开始时就采取更强硬立场的人来说，这些话可能已经足够有力。

cues.en: Karl Nasman in Philadelphia. Let's focus now on what's happening inside Gaza.
cues.zh: 费城的 Karl Nasman 报道。现在让我们关注加沙内部的情况。

cues.en: For the first time since the Hamas attacks on Israel sparked the devastating war,
cues.zh: 自哈马斯袭击以色列引发这场毁灭性战争以来，

cues.en: half a million children in Gaza are returning to formal education with the start of the academic school year.
cues.zh: 加沙有五十万儿童随着新学年开始，重返正规教育。

cues.en: That's happening even though the UN says 97% of schools in the Palestinian territory are damaged or destroyed.
cues.zh: 尽管联合国称，这片巴勒斯坦领土上 97% 的学校已受损或被毁，这一情况仍在发生。

cues.en: Jacob Evans reports.
cues.zh: Jacob Evans 报道。

cues.en: The first day back at school can be a nerve-racking moment.
cues.zh: 重返学校的第一天可能令人紧张。

cues.en: For young Muayyad Abu Mustafa, it's a feeling of excitement instead.
cues.zh: 但对年幼的 Muayyad Abu Mustafa 来说，这反而是一种兴奋的感觉。

cues.en: The last time I've been to school was three years ago.
cues.zh: 我上一次去学校是三年前。

cues.en: Now we're starting the school year. It's a year for joy, happiness and success.
cues.zh: 现在我们要开始新学年了。这一年将充满喜悦、幸福和成功。

cues.en: Gaza's health ministry says 22,000 children have been killed by Israel since the war began.
cues.zh: 加沙卫生部称，自战争开始以来，已有 2.2 万名儿童被以色列杀害。

cues.en: Countless more have been injured and traumatised,
cues.zh: 还有无数儿童受伤并留下创伤，

cues.en: children like Muayyad. We've lost our friends during the war. We are here alone.
cues.zh: 像 Muayyad 这样的孩子。战争中我们失去了朋友。我们孤零零地在这里。

cues.en: We don't have good clothes. We have nothing, not even good shoes.
cues.zh: 我们没有像样的衣服。我们什么都没有，连双好鞋也没有。

cues.en: The stationery before the war was cheap. Now it's expensive. We don't have notebooks or pencils.
cues.zh: 战前文具便宜，现在很贵。我们没有笔记本和铅笔。

cues.en: And despite all this, we will learn. We will learn even in a tent.
cues.zh: 尽管如此，我们还是会学习。即使在帐篷里也要学习。

cues.en: There have been some temporary learning spaces run by various agencies in the last few years.
cues.zh: 过去几年里，各机构运营过一些临时学习场所。

cues.en: But now, by working alongside the UN, the education ministry has been able to open about 700 education facilities across Gaza
cues.zh: 但现在，教育部与联合国合作，已能在加沙各地开设约 700 所教育设施，

cues.en: as part of the plan to get formal schooling back underway.
cues.zh: 这是让正规教育重新运转起来的计划的一部分。

cues.en: Pictures online show children sat on bare floors inside tents.
cues.zh: 网上的照片显示，孩子们坐在帐篷里的光秃地面上。

cues.en: Others show pupils sat in the remnants of schools, chalkboards peppered with gunfire.
cues.zh: 另一些照片显示，学生坐在学校的残垣中，黑板上满是弹孔。

cues.en: However, despite the ceasefire being implemented last year, the fighting in Gaza is not over.
cues.zh: 然而，尽管去年实施了停火，加沙的战斗并未结束。

cues.en: Om Jibril Hamida fears for her kids.
cues.zh: Om Jibril Hamida 担心自己的孩子。

cues.en: We want our children to live like the other children in the world.
cues.zh: 我们希望孩子们能像世界各地的其他孩子一样生活。

cues.en: It's a long way to school. We had transport before, but now there's none to keep my son safe.
cues.zh: 去学校路很远，过去我们有交通工具，但现在没有任何东西保障我儿子的安全。

cues.en: When he leaves, I ask God to keep him safe.
cues.zh: 他出门时，我祈求上帝保佑他平安。

cues.en: I'm afraid because the war is not over yet and there are still people being targeted,
cues.zh: 我很害怕，因为战争还没有结束，仍有人遭到袭击，

cues.en: which means my son and daughter can be hit by shrapnel on their way to school.
cues.zh: 这意味着我的儿子和女儿在去学校的路上可能被弹片击中。

cues.en: Her fears are not without precedent.
cues.zh: 她的担忧并非没有先例。

cues.en: On Saturday, at least three people were reportedly killed in the latest Israeli attacks, including a 10-year-old girl who was shot.
cues.zh: 据报道，周六以色列最新的袭击至少造成三人死亡，其中包括一名遭枪击的 10 岁女孩。

cues.en: There's been no reply from Israel. Jacob Evans.
cues.zh: 以色列尚未回应。Jacob Evans。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia is one of the richest and most powerful countries in the Middle East, and yet,
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯是中东最富裕、最强大的国家之一，然而，

cues.en: on Saturday, an area near the capital's international airport was hit in a drone strike.
cues.zh: 周六，首都国际机场附近一带遭到无人机袭击。

cues.en: Riyadh images showed a black tower of smoke after an oil depot appeared to be targeted.
cues.zh: 利雅得的画面显示，一座油库似乎遭到袭击后，黑色烟柱升入天空。

cues.en: Other strikes hit the Saudi Red Sea city of Yanbu.
cues.zh: 其他袭击击中了沙特红海城市延布。

cues.en: Yemen's Houthi rebels have already claimed responsibility for those attacks, marking a major uptick in the Houthi pressure on the Saudis.
cues.zh: 也门胡塞武装已宣称对这些袭击负责，标志着胡塞对沙特施加的压力大幅上升。

cues.en: The Houthis are already blockading a key Red Sea shipping route for Saudi oil and hitting Saudi oil facilities with drones and missiles.
cues.zh: 胡塞武装已经封锁一条供沙特石油运输的关键红海航线，并用无人机和导弹袭击沙特石油设施。

cues.en: Globally, the Houthis' growing assertiveness could have an impact on the prices we all pay for oil and gas.
cues.zh: 从全球来看，胡塞武装日益强硬的行动可能影响我们为石油和天然气支付的价格。

cues.en: And inside Saudi Arabia, the conflict is being felt, too.
cues.zh: 在沙特境内，人们也感受到了这场冲突的影响。

cues.en: Saturday's strikes marked the first time since the recent escalation that the city's residents have received an alert on their phones urging them to stay indoors.
cues.zh: 周六的袭击发生后，这座城市的居民自局势近期升级以来首次收到手机警报，被要求留在室内。

cues.en: James Copnall heard more from Aziz Alghashian from the Gulf International Forum in Riyadh.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·科普纳尔从驻利雅得的海湾国际论坛成员阿齐兹·阿尔加希安那里了解了更多情况。

cues.en: I think there was an attempt by the Houthis to really strike at the airport.
cues.zh: 我认为胡塞武装确实试图袭击机场。

cues.en: And, you know, many people have been discussing that there were alarms going off on their phones, and that's something that's happening here.
cues.zh: 很多人都在谈论自己的手机响起警报，这种情况正在这里发生。

cues.en: Basically, these alarms are to make sure that we have to take some safe refuge.
cues.zh: 基本上，这些警报是为了提醒我们必须寻找安全的避难处。

cues.en: I think for the people in the south of Saudi and places such as Abha, Khamis Mushait, Asir and Najran,
cues.zh: 我想，对沙特南部以及艾卜哈、海米斯穆谢特、阿西尔和奈季兰等地的人们来说，

cues.en: these are the places that are really close to the Yemeni border, close to the Houthi strongholds.
cues.zh: 这些地方非常靠近也门边境，也靠近胡塞武装的据点。

cues.en: They receive it far more there.
cues.zh: 那里收到的警报要频繁得多。

cues.en: However, I think for Riyadh, the last time something like this happened
cues.zh: 不过，我想对利雅得来说，上一次发生类似情况

cues.en: was actually when the Iran-US war was still in full swing, and so that was a few months ago.
cues.zh: 其实是在几个月前伊朗与美国的战争仍处于全面激战时。

cues.en: That was maybe in April. I remember it very vividly in March and Ramadan, when the phones were going off.
cues.zh: 那大概是在四月。我清楚记得三月和斋月期间，手机警报不断响起。

cues.en: But it's rare, I think, for Saudis to have it, and people living in Riyadh found it concerning.
cues.zh: 但我想，沙特人很少遇到这种情况，住在利雅得的人对此感到担忧。

cues.en: A sort of wake-up call, then, for the people of Riyadh, that things are potentially going in a bad direction?
cues.zh: 所以，这对利雅得居民来说，算是一个警钟，意味着事态可能正朝着糟糕的方向发展？

cues.en: Before the ceasefire that took place in 2022, in 2021, I remember vividly also hearing loud explosions.
cues.zh: 在2022年达成停火之前，也就是2021年，我清楚记得曾听到巨大的爆炸声。

cues.en: But since then, I think the Saudi authorities took it upon themselves to install alarms and early warning systems
cues.zh: 但从那以后，我想沙特当局主动安装了警报和预警系统，

cues.en: for citizens and people living there.
cues.zh: 为公民和当地居民提供预警。

cues.en: I would say the wake-up call is literally a wake-up call because it did wake us up
cues.zh: 我想，这个警钟确实就是字面意义上的警钟，因为它把我们叫醒，

cues.en: around three or four in the morning, and it just reminds everyone that there is a situation happening.
cues.zh: 时间大约是凌晨三四点，也提醒所有人确实有事正在发生。

cues.en: It's also worth noting that Riyadh is actually very, very big. You know, it is a huge city.
cues.zh: 还值得注意的是，利雅得其实非常大，是一座巨大的城市。

cues.en: So, while people may hear it in one place, they may not hear the explosions or see the remnants of these explosions in other places.
cues.zh: 所以，人们可能在一个地方听到警报，却不一定能在其他地方听到爆炸声或看到爆炸残留物。

cues.en: So the Saudi social media, the official accounts, keep indicating time and again that, you know, giving these warnings
cues.zh: 因此，沙特社交媒体和官方账号不断反复说明并发布这些警告，

cues.en: and saying, 'Hey, there are these warnings that are happening.'
cues.zh: 并说：“注意，这些警报正在发生。”

cues.en: So I have to say there are these reminders, but it's a reminder that there is a simmering situation. A situation is under control. That's what they're trying to communicate.
cues.zh: 所以我得说，这些是提醒，但也提醒人们局势正在酝酿之中。他们想传达的是，局势仍在控制之下。

cues.en: You're about to take a flight. How do you feel about taking a flight from Riyadh International Airport?
cues.zh: 你马上要乘飞机了。从利雅得国际机场起飞，你感觉如何？

cues.en: I feel confident because, if I was closer to the border, I would be more concerned.
cues.zh: 我感到放心，因为如果离边境更近，我会更加担忧。

cues.en: Moreover, I think because I'm a traveler and a researcher,
cues.zh: 此外，我想因为我是旅行者和研究人员，

cues.en: and so I think being stuck in airports due to conflicts is something I'm a little bit used to.
cues.zh: 所以因冲突滞留机场，对我来说多少已经有些习惯了。

cues.en: So, I think I'm a little bit apprehensive and hopefully this won't be something more than just a delay.
cues.zh: 所以我有些忐忑，希望这不会不只是一次延误之外的更大问题。

cues.en: But in my opinion right now, because we are in Riyadh, literally in the heart of Saudi Arabia, I'm feeling more confident than apprehensive.
cues.zh: 但在我看来，既然我们现在身处利雅得、沙特的腹地，我的安心多于担忧。

cues.en: What about diplomacy in the region? Are the Saudi authorities speaking directly to the Iranians who back the Houthis
cues.zh: 那该地区的外交呢？沙特当局是否在直接和支持胡塞武装的伊朗人交涉，

cues.en: and telling them to back off, telling them this is unacceptable?
cues.zh: 要求他们收手，告诉他们这是不可接受的？

cues.en: They are, and that's why the Saudi diplomatic channels and the bilateral relationship have not been severed during the war.
cues.zh: 他们在交涉，这就是为什么战争期间沙伊外交渠道和双边关系没有中断。

cues.en: While we have our diplomatic channels with them, we are also using and trying to leverage the diplomatic channels that we have
cues.zh: 我们与伊朗保持外交渠道，同时也在利用并试图借助我们拥有的外交渠道，

cues.en: with both China and Pakistan, our new ally, in order for them to begin to influence
cues.zh: 包括与中国和我们的新盟友巴基斯坦的渠道，让他们开始施加影响，

cues.en: or encourage Iran to rein in the Houthis.
cues.zh: 或敦促伊朗约束胡塞武装。

cues.en: Aziz Alghashian. Staying with this story,
cues.zh: 阿齐兹·阿尔加希安。继续关注这条新闻，

cues.en: these latest attacks are likely to increase pressure on the United States to intervene more directly against the Houthis.
cues.zh: 这些最新袭击可能加大美国更直接介入、打击胡塞武装的压力。

cues.en: John Sfakianakis is chief economist at the Gulf Research Center in Riyadh. He says the current escalation is clearly destabilizing the region.
cues.zh: 约翰·斯法基亚纳基斯是利雅得海湾研究中心的首席经济学家。他说，目前的升级显然正在破坏地区稳定。

cues.en: Well, it is damaging for everybody and nobody is spared from this.
cues.zh: 这对所有人都有害，没有人能置身事外。

cues.en: The UAE in the past was attacked, Qatar, we've seen Kuwait and, of course, Saudi Arabia now. And of course, something has to be done.
cues.zh: 阿联酋过去遭到过袭击，卡塔尔、科威特也经历过，现在当然轮到沙特。显然必须采取行动。

cues.en: And here, we need both the Gulf countries to support Saudi Arabia and the U.S. to step in.
cues.zh: 在这里，我们既需要海湾国家支持沙特，也需要美国介入。

cues.en: The U.S. needs to take a more active role, as it has distanced itself, because oil prices and freedom of navigation are so important.
cues.zh: 美国已经疏远此事，因此需要发挥更积极的作用，因为油价和航行自由都至关重要。

cues.en: Now we have both straits under some kind of closure, and it's quite difficult to get product, oil out.
cues.zh: 目前两条海峡都处于某种封锁状态，石油等产品很难运出。

cues.en: That is quite critical because it is four to five percent of global oil
cues.zh: 这非常关键，因为受影响的石油占全球石油的4%至5%，

cues.en: that we're seeing being taken off, and there is no additional five percent or five million barrels being taken back in by any of the countries.
cues.zh: 也就是说，这部分供应正在退出市场，而没有任何国家补回额外的5%或500万桶。

cues.en: And oil is at 103, 104 dollars a barrel.
cues.zh: 目前油价为每桶103至104美元。

cues.en: It could easily go to 130, 140 if it is not addressed.
cues.zh: 如果问题得不到解决，油价很容易升至130或140美元。

cues.en: The US has to step in. John Sfakianakis in Riyadh.
cues.zh: 美国必须介入。约翰·斯法基纳基斯在利雅得报道。

cues.en: As men get older, many of them start seeing a gradual loss of the Y chromosome in some of their body tissue.
cues.zh: 随着男性年龄增长，许多人身体的一些组织会逐渐失去Y染色体。

cues.en: Until a few years ago, it was thought that this was a harmless side effect of ageing.
cues.zh: 几年前，人们还认为这是衰老带来的无害副作用。

cues.en: But new research suggests that this process can increase the risk of cancer.
cues.zh: 但新的研究表明，这一过程可能增加患癌风险。

cues.en: American scientists have found evidence that Y chromosome loss was greatest in the areas around tumors.
cues.zh: 美国科学家发现，肿瘤周围区域的Y染色体丢失最为严重。

cues.en: Mark Jobling is professor of genetics at England's Leicester University. He told us more about the study.
cues.zh: 马克·乔布林是英国莱斯特大学遗传学教授。他向我们进一步介绍了这项研究。

cues.en: The Y chromosome is sex-determining. So what that means is, when an embryo is developing,
cues.zh: Y染色体决定性别。这意味着，胚胎发育时，

cues.en: if it has a Y chromosome, then it will become a male, and if it doesn't, then it will become a female.
cues.zh: 如果有Y染色体，就会发育成男性；如果没有，就会发育成女性。

cues.en: When cells divide, they have to carry out a kind of complex dance of the chromosomes
cues.zh: 细胞分裂时，染色体必须进行一种复杂的运作，

cues.en: to make sure that the two daughter cells inherit the right numbers of chromosomes.
cues.zh: 以确保两个子细胞继承数量正确的染色体。

cues.en: And sometimes that goes wrong, and it goes increasingly wrong as we age.
cues.zh: 但有时会出错，而且随着年龄增长，出错会越来越严重。

cues.en: The Y chromosome is actually the smallest chromosome we have, and that may make it more vulnerable to this kind of problem.
cues.zh: Y染色体其实是我们拥有的最小染色体，这可能让它更容易出现这类问题。

cues.en: So in the general population, about 40% of men over 70 show this phenomenon.
cues.zh: 在普通人群中，约40%的70岁以上男性会出现这种现象。

cues.en: And it's not all the cells in the body that lose the Y chromosome. It's a proportion, and that proportion will vary.
cues.zh: 并不是身体所有细胞都会失去Y染色体，只是一部分细胞，而且比例会有所不同。

cues.en: That loss is associated with a wide range of cancers, not just male-specific cancers.
cues.zh: 这种丢失与多种癌症有关，不只是男性特有的癌症。

cues.en: But these are cancers that affect both men and women.
cues.zh: 这些癌症会影响男性和女性。

cues.en: It seems that men who have loss of Y chromosome, their tumours may be differently sensitive
cues.zh: 看来，失去Y染色体的男性，其肿瘤对某些治疗的敏感性可能不同，

cues.en: to certain chemotherapeutic drugs and to radiotherapy.
cues.zh: 对某些化疗药物和放射治疗的反应也可能不同。

cues.en: So it could be in the future that if a man has loss of Y chromosome, then he may be treated slightly differently.
cues.zh: 因此，未来如果男性失去Y染色体，治疗方式可能会略有不同。

cues.en: It's rather early days in that, though, Professor Mark Jobling.
cues.zh: 不过，这方面目前还处于早期阶段。马克·乔布林教授。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: it essentially used publicly available information.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后：它主要利用公开信息，

cues.en: to kind of guess at credentials, including, in one case, a password.
cues.zh: 试图猜测登录凭据，其中一个案例甚至涉及密码。

cues.en: Google's Gemini becomes the latest AI model to go on an autonomous hacking spree.
cues.zh: 谷歌的Gemini成为最新一个进行自主黑客攻击的人工智能模型。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: South Africans have taken to the streets.
cues.zh: 南非民众走上街头。

cues.en: Protesters are calling on the police to do more to deal with the country's staggering levels of femicides
cues.zh: 抗议者要求警方采取更多行动，应对该国惊人的女性被杀害事件数量，

cues.en: following the murders of nine women in eastern Johannesburg in recent months.
cues.zh: 近几个月东约翰内斯堡已有9名女性遇害。

cues.en: One of the women, Elizabeth Moselakgomo, was killed while out for a run.
cues.zh: 其中一名女性伊丽莎白·莫塞拉克戈莫在外出跑步时遇害。

cues.en: Runners organized an event to honor her and defend the right of women to run freely in a country
cues.zh: 跑者组织活动悼念她，并捍卫女性在这个国家自由跑步的权利，

cues.en: that has one of the highest rates of violence in the world.
cues.zh: 该国的暴力率位居世界前列。

cues.en: These people explained why they were taking part.
cues.zh: 参加者解释了他们参与的原因。

cues.en: I'm scared for my life. My mother's scared, my granny, everyone.
cues.zh: 我害怕自己会没命。我母亲害怕，我的外婆也害怕，所有人都害怕。

cues.en: Every woman in our lives, they're all thinking of this anxiousness of why are we even here.
cues.zh: 我母亲害怕，我的外婆也害怕，我们生命中的每位女性都在焦虑：我们为什么还要身处这样的处境？

cues.en: We need active policing, we need patrolling, we need visibility with police.
cues.zh: 我们需要积极执法，需要巡逻，需要看得见的警察。

cues.en: I think as men across the country, let's call it out when we see it.
cues.zh: 我认为，全国男性都应在看到这种事时指出来。

cues.en: Let's do our part and what I call country duty.
cues.zh: 让我们尽自己的一份力，履行我所谓的国家责任。

cues.en: Let's not condone these type of things and think that it doesn't affect us.
cues.zh: 我们不能纵容这类事情，也不能以为它与我们无关。

cues.en: It does. Janat Jaleel spoke to our correspondent in Johannesburg.
cues.zh: 事实并非如此。贾纳特·贾利勒采访了我们在约翰内斯堡的记者。

cues.en: Pumza Fihlani. Some of the sentiments that you heard expressed
cues.zh: 普姆扎·菲拉尼。你刚才听到的一些观点，

cues.en: There in fact I've heard repeated over the last few days in various communities that I've visited.
cues.zh: 事实上，我过去几天走访不同社区时，也反复听到了这些观点。

cues.en: The main thing that people are calling for, they're saying that it cannot be business as usual in South Africa.
cues.zh: 人们主要呼吁的是，南非不能再一切照旧。

cues.en: All too often, they say, we are in these heightened moments where there are spates of killings and there seems to be an upsurge of interest
cues.zh: 他们说，我们经常经历这样的紧张时刻：一连串杀戮发生，公众关注似乎上升，

cues.en: and soon that then fizzles away, and very little happens in terms of prosecutions and even arrests.
cues.zh: 但很快热度消退，起诉甚至逮捕几乎没有进展。

cues.en: And they're saying that that needs to change, saying that this is perhaps another moment
cues.zh: 他们说这种情况必须改变，也许现在又到了一个时刻，

cues.en: where South Africans can rally and increase their demands on the government and the pressure
cues.zh: 南非民众可以团结起来，向政府提出更多要求并施加压力，

cues.en: that they put on officials to make sure that something changes this time.
cues.zh: 敦促官员确保这一次有所改变。

cues.en: And how have the authorities been responding?
cues.zh: 当局对此作何回应？

cues.en: Well, they've said President Cyril Ramaphosa, in reaction to the discoveries of these bodies, has assembled a specialized team
cues.zh: 他们表示，总统西里尔·拉马福萨在发现这些尸体后，组建了一个特别小组，

cues.en: That includes ministers. He's committed that they will ensure these murders are treated as a high-priority issue.
cues.zh: 小组成员包括部长。他承诺，他们会确保将这些谋杀案列为高度优先事项。

cues.en: All the resources needed will be channelled towards the investigation.
cues.zh: 所需的一切资源都将投入这项调查。

cues.en: This could mean investigating officers and possibly finding prosecutors who will take on these cases when it eventually gets to that stage.
cues.zh: 这可能意味着调查人员，以及在案件最终进入这一阶段时负责审理的检察官。

cues.en: But some people are skeptical.
cues.zh: 但有些人对此持怀疑态度。

cues.en: They are saying, "We've been there before."
cues.zh: 他们说：“我们以前经历过这种情况。”

cues.en: That it's not a matter of policies.
cues.zh: 问题不在于有没有政策。

cues.en: That the policies exist.
cues.zh: 政策是存在的。

cues.en: Just last year alone, this was declared a national disaster.
cues.zh: 仅仅去年，这就被宣布为国家灾难。

cues.en: The government says all the right things, but it's the implementation that's a problem.
cues.zh: 政府说的都对，但问题在于落实。

cues.en: They're also saying on the sidelines of that, these are now gender campaigners.
cues.zh: 此外，性别平等活动人士也在一旁提出意见。

cues.en: They're saying another thing that needs to be addressed can only be led at government level.
cues.zh: 他们说，另一项必须解决的问题只能由政府层面主导。

cues.en: Are the harmful attitudes that some men in South Africa hold towards women.
cues.zh: 那就是南非一些男性对女性抱持的有害态度。

cues.en: And they are saying that the manifestation of that violence is what we are seeing there, and repeatedly,
cues.zh: 他们说，这种暴力的表现正是我们在那里反复看到的现象，

cues.en: whenever there are cases of sexual violence against women, and in the worst cases, murder.
cues.zh: 每当发生针对女性的性暴力案件，最严重时甚至会导致谋杀。

cues.en: Pumza Fihlani.
cues.zh: 普姆扎·菲赫拉尼。

cues.en: Germany is holding two state elections this weekend.
cues.zh: 德国本周末将举行两场州选举。

cues.en: Normally, such votes don't generate much interest outside the country's borders, but that's not the case this time.
cues.zh: 通常，这类投票在德国境外不会引起太多关注，但这次并非如此。

cues.en: This is part of the reason why.
cues.zh: 这就是原因之一。

cues.en: That was the scene two weeks ago in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt, where the far-right
cues.zh: 两周前，德国东部萨克森-安哈尔特州就出现了这样的场景；在那里，极右翼

cues.en: Alternative for Deutschland, or AfD, recorded its best-ever result, but without winning an absolute majority.
cues.zh: 德国选择党（AfD）创下历史最佳成绩，但没有赢得绝对多数。

cues.en: Now, all eyes are on the AfD to see if it can continue its political rise in this weekend's elections.
cues.zh: 现在，所有目光都集中在德国选择党身上，看它能否在本周末的选举中延续政治上升势头。

cues.en: And that could further increase the pressure on Germany's highly unpopular leader Friedrich Merz to stand aside
cues.zh: 这可能进一步加大压力，迫使德国极不受欢迎的领导人弗里德里希·默茨退居二线，

cues.en: for someone who can revive the fortunes of this once-dominant CDU party,
cues.zh: 让位给能够重振这个曾占主导地位的基民盟的人，

cues.en: especially if the CDU fails to reach the minimum 5% threshold in one of the states.
cues.zh: 尤其是如果基民盟在其中一个州达不到最低5%的门槛。

cues.en: Jessica Parker is our Berlin correspondent.
cues.zh: 杰西卡·帕克是我们的柏林记者。

cues.en: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has cancelled a trip to the UN General Assembly in New York that was due to happen early next week,
cues.zh: 总理弗里德里希·默茨取消了原定下周初前往纽约参加联合国大会的行程，

cues.en: and that's widely being read as a signal of how seriously he and his team are taking it,
cues.zh: 这被广泛解读为一个信号，表明他及其团队对此事的重视程度，

cues.en: Although they didn't say exactly why he cancelled it, except to say that his presence was required in Berlin.
cues.zh: 尽管他们没有确切说明取消行程的原因，只说他需要留在柏林。

cues.en: We have seen over the last couple of days eight state premiers from the CDU come out in support of Chancellor Friedrich Merz,
cues.zh: 过去几天，已有八位来自基民盟的州长公开表示支持总理弗里德里希·默茨，

cues.en: although some felt the letter that they issued was rather lukewarm.
cues.zh: 不过，有些人认为他们发布的信函支持力度相当有限。

cues.en: But there are these endless rumours swirling, and they have been for months, but they've really ratcheted up
cues.zh: 但有关此事的传言一直不断，已经持续数月，而且最近明显升温，

cues.en: this idea of a chancellor swap because Friedrich Merz increasingly has been seen as something of an electoral liability for the CDU.
cues.zh: 即更换总理的想法，因为弗里德里希·默茨越来越被视为基民盟的选举负担。

cues.en: He is certainly not being put front and centre for the campaigns in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
cues.zh: 在柏林和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州的竞选中，他显然没有被放在核心位置。

cues.en: Friedrich Merz talked about trying to take the fight to Alternative for Deutschland with good, competent government.
cues.zh: 弗里德里希·默茨谈到，要以良好且有能力的政府与德国选择党竞争。

cues.en: Famously, once upon a time, a long time ago, he talked about even halving their vote.
cues.zh: 众所周知，很久以前，他曾谈到甚至要让该党的得票减半。

cues.en: The opposite has happened, and the AfD is surging in support.
cues.zh: 但结果恰恰相反，德国选择党的支持率正在飙升。

cues.en: That's seen as a big problem, that he's failed to take on Alternative for Deutschland, seen as a big problem within his own party.
cues.zh: 这被视为一个大问题：他未能对抗德国选择党，而这在他自己的党内也被视为严重问题。

cues.en: His communication style often comes under a lot of scrutiny as well. People see him as abrasive, somewhat gaffe-prone.
cues.zh: 他的沟通风格也经常受到严厉审视。人们认为他生硬，有时还容易失言。

cues.en: And look, I have met plenty of people in Germany who are none too fond of Friedrich Merz, and his personal approval ratings are very low.
cues.zh: 我在德国遇到过很多不太喜欢弗里德里希·默茨的人，而他的个人支持率也非常低。

cues.en: He's also trying to push forward a bunch of reforms, some of which are very unpopular or have been criticized, for example, around pensions.
cues.zh: 他还在推动一系列改革，其中一些非常不得人心，或受到批评，例如养老金改革。

cues.en: He himself has kind of seemed to concede that this government needs to communicate better with people,
cues.zh: 他本人似乎也承认，本届政府需要更好地与民众沟通，

cues.en: but he is a man who, I think, is now seen as facing a potentially make-or-break weekend for him.
cues.zh: 但我认为，如今人们看来，这个周末对他的政治生涯可能是成败攸关的。

cues.en: Jessica Parker in Berlin.
cues.zh: 柏林的杰西卡·帕克报道。

cues.en: Google has confirmed that its artificial intelligence system Gemini broke out of a testing environment and hacked into three companies in May.
cues.zh: 谷歌证实，其人工智能系统 Gemini 在五月突破测试环境并入侵了三家公司。

cues.en: It's the latest such incident, raising concerns that AI organizations may not be able to keep their systems under control.
cues.zh: 这是最新一起此类事件，引发了人们对人工智能机构可能无法控制其系统的担忧。

cues.en: Our business correspondent Megan Owen is following developments.
cues.zh: 我们的商业记者梅根·欧文正在跟进事态发展。

cues.en: This happened back in May when Gemini was undergoing cybersecurity testing.
cues.zh: 事情发生在五月，当时 Gemini 正在接受网络安全测试。

cues.en: By an independent company, and according to Google, it essentially used publicly available information to kind of guess at credentials,
cues.zh: 谷歌称，独立公司进行测试时，Gemini 基本利用公开信息猜测凭据，

cues.en: including, in one case, a password, to hack into some websites that it thought were part of the testing,
cues.zh: 其中一次甚至猜中了密码，用来入侵它以为属于测试范围的一些网站，

cues.en: but they actually weren't.
cues.zh: 但这些网站其实并不属于测试范围。

cues.en: Now Google says it did stop.
cues.zh: 谷歌现在表示，它确实已叫停这种行为。

cues.en: It's informed the companies that they were hacked during this testing, and it's now working to change its training in accordance.
cues.zh: 谷歌已告知这些公司它们在测试期间遭到入侵，并正据此调整训练方式。

cues.en: But it also says that this highlights the importance of training AI and its models to operate responsibly.
cues.zh: 但谷歌也说，这凸显了训练人工智能及其模型，使其负责任运行的重要性。

cues.en: In the past few months, we've seen similar incidents.
cues.zh: 过去几个月，我们见到了类似事件。

cues.en: For example, back in July, Anthropic's Claude said that it had kind of broken out of its test environment
cues.zh: 例如，七月，Anthropic 的 Claude 表示，它曾以某种方式突破测试环境，

cues.en: by somehow connecting to the internet when it was meant to be in a kind of isolated situation.
cues.zh: 通过连接互联网，而当时它本应处于某种隔离状态。

cues.en: At a similar time, OpenAI said that one of its models during a test had carried out cyberattacks against several publicly available companies.
cues.zh: 大约在同一时期，OpenAI表示，其一个模型在测试期间对几家公开可访问的公司发起了网络攻击。

cues.en: And what's interesting is the company said that it had operated in a kind of superhuman way,
cues.zh: 有意思的是，该公司称这个模型以某种超越人类的方式运行，

cues.en: so it was making mistakes and decisions that no human hacker would have been able to make.
cues.zh: 因此它犯下了一些错误，也作出了一些人类黑客不可能作出的决定。

cues.en: Megan Owen. We end with a new documentary called The Oldest Person in the World, which explores aging, longevity, and mortality.
cues.zh: 梅根·欧文。最后是一部新纪录片《世界上最年长的人》，探讨衰老、长寿与死亡。

cues.en: It follows the journey of Sam Green, a New York-based filmmaker.
cues.zh: 影片讲述纽约电影制片人萨姆·格林的经历。

cues.en: He spends a decade meeting various people bestowed with the oldest living person title.
cues.zh: 他花了十年时间，探访曾获“在世最年长者”称号的人们。

cues.en: The BBC's Tom Brook went to meet him.
cues.zh: BBC记者汤姆·布鲁克前去采访他。

cues.en: I know this might sound weird, but I've been obsessed with the oldest person in the world for years.
cues.zh: 我知道这听起来可能很奇怪，但多年来我一直对世界上最年长的人着迷。

cues.en: Meet adventurous, Brooklyn-based, Oscar-nominated filmmaker Sam Green.
cues.zh: 认识一下这位热爱冒险、住在布鲁克林、曾获奥斯卡提名的电影制片人萨姆·格林。

cues.en: Since 2015, he's been traveling the world, chronicling the forever-changing holders of the title of oldest person in the world.
cues.zh: 自2015年以来，他一直在世界各地旅行，记录“世界上最年长的人”这一称号不断更替的持有者。

cues.en: His survey has included Kane Tanaka in Japan, who held the title for four years.
cues.zh: 他的记录对象包括日本的田中加子，她曾持有这一称号四年。

cues.en: And then, there's the oldest person ever, France's Jeanne Calment, who when she died in 1997 was 122 years old.
cues.zh: 还有有史以来最长寿的人、法国的让娜·卡尔芒，她于1997年去世时享年122岁。

cues.en: In her later years, she recorded a rap album.
cues.zh: 她晚年还录制过一张说唱专辑。

cues.en: Sam Green's investigation of these very senior citizens has become a lifelong project.
cues.zh: 萨姆·格林对这些高龄老人的记录，已经成为他毕生的项目。

cues.en: A documentary based on his survey so far has just been released.
cues.zh: 一部基于他目前记录成果的纪录片刚刚上映。

cues.en: He's long been fascinated by why the news media and the public are so interested in the title holder of the oldest person in the world.
cues.zh: 他一直着迷于一个问题：新闻媒体和公众为什么如此关注“世界上最年长的人”这一称号的持有者。

cues.en: To this day, I still don't fully understand it. Is this a fear of death? Is this a fear of fate
cues.zh: 直到今天，我仍未完全理解。这是对死亡的恐惧吗？是对命运的恐惧吗？

cues.en: or, you know, one of those things like with a car crash where you can't look away, but you don't want to look at.
cues.zh: 或者说，就像车祸一样，你无法移开目光，却又不想看。

cues.en: In making his documentary, Sam Green found there was nearly always a desire on the part of others to find out if there's a secret to longevity.
cues.zh: 制作纪录片时，萨姆·格林发现，旁人几乎总想知道长寿是否有什么秘诀。

cues.en: The elderly people he observed had all kinds of answers for why they'd led a long life.
cues.zh: 他观察的老人们，对自己为何长寿都有各种各样的答案。

cues.en: One woman stated she'd lived for a long time because she'd stayed away from men.
cues.zh: 一位女性说，自己长寿是因为一直远离男性。

cues.en: She also said her secret was eating three raw eggs a day, too.
cues.zh: 她还说，自己的秘诀是每天吃三个生鸡蛋。

cues.en: You know, so, it's like the media descends on these people, everybody asks them what their secret is.
cues.zh: 所以，媒体蜂拥而至，人人都问这些人长寿的秘诀。

cues.en: They say something and everybody runs with that.
cues.zh: 他们说出一个答案，所有人就纷纷传播。

cues.en: This documentary often shows that the outside world is much more intrigued by the oldest person in the world than the subjects who hold that title.
cues.zh: 这部纪录片常常展现出，比起称号的持有者，其他人、外部世界往往对世界上最年长的人更感兴趣。

cues.en: But this film isn't just about the very old.
cues.zh: 但这部电影不只是关于高龄老人。

cues.en: It's also about life and death, and events in the filmmaker's own life, the birth of a son and his own confrontation with a life-threatening illness.
cues.zh: 它也关于生与死，以及制片人自己人生中的事件：儿子的出生，还有他本人面对危及生命的疾病。

cues.en: These things started to creep into the movie, so over time it becomes a larger meditation, I hope,
cues.zh: 这些事情逐渐进入电影，因此随着时间推移，我希望它成为更宏大的思考，

cues.en: about time and the mysteries of being alive and fate and all these big questions that we ask ourselves.
cues.zh: 思考时间、活着的奥秘、命运，以及我们不断自问的所有重大问题。

cues.en: The last person I interviewed, a Spanish woman named Maria Branyas, she was very funny. She even was making fun of me, which I loved.
cues.zh: 我采访的最后一位是名叫玛丽亚·布拉尼亚斯的西班牙女性，她非常风趣，甚至拿我开玩笑，我很喜欢。

cues.en: But, at a moment in the interview she said, 'You are young. Now is the time to do good works.'
cues.zh: 但采访中有一刻她说：“你还年轻，现在正是行善的时候。”

cues.en: What she was saying is, 'You're young and you have time, so use it.'
cues.zh: 她的意思是：“你还年轻，还有时间，所以要好好利用。”

cues.en: And I think that's a beautiful thing to appreciate.
cues.zh: 我觉得这是一件值得珍惜的美好事情。

cues.en: Over the last 10 years, Sam Green has met many of those who've held the title of oldest person in the world.
cues.zh: 过去十年里，萨姆·格林见过许多曾获“世界上最年长的人”称号的人。

cues.en: But there's been one holdout, the current title holder, 117-year-old Ethel Caterham, who lives in Surrey, just outside London.
cues.zh: 但有一人始终没有接受采访：现任称号持有者、117岁的埃塞尔·卡特勒姆，她住在伦敦郊外的萨里。

cues.en: She was born in Edwardian times. She is the first person in 10 years who has rebuffed my overtures.
cues.zh: 她出生于爱德华时代，是十年来第一个拒绝我的邀请的人。

cues.en: But she did let King Charles visit her, didn't she? I know. I saw a video of her and King Charles and I thought, 'Charles, not me?'
cues.zh: 但她确实让查尔斯国王去看望她了，对吧？我知道。我看过她和查尔斯国王的视频，心想：“查尔斯？不是我？”

cues.en: You know, she is British. She's the last Edwardian.
cues.zh: 你看，她是英国人，是最后一位爱德华时代的人。

cues.en: So I guess she feels some allegiance to the King, but, you know, come on, I've been doing this for ten years.
cues.zh: 所以我猜她对国王有些忠诚，但拜托，我做这件事已经十年了。

cues.en: Even though this documentary focuses on the very old and very fragile,
cues.zh: 尽管这部纪录片关注的是年迈而脆弱的人，

cues.en: it makes the point that there is much to learn from observing them, and from the filmmaker himself, about what it means to live a thoughtful life.
cues.zh: 它指出，我们可以从观察他们以及制片人本人身上，学到如何过一种深思熟虑的人生。

cues.en: It is an unexpectedly life-affirming film. Tom Brook.
cues.zh: 这是一部出人意料地肯定生命的电影。汤姆·布鲁克。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期全部内容。如需联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service. Use the hashtag GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X平台关注BBC World Service，并使用话题标签GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Chris Ablakwa and the producer was Stephen Jensen.
cues.zh: 本期由克里斯·阿布拉夸混音，制片人是斯蒂芬·詹森。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin. I am Celia Hatton. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是西莉亚·哈顿。下次再见。
